title: Repair EEG benchmark response-locked timing and artifact metadata
description: The EEG benchmark and several EDA/FCCA scripts hardcode 256 samples, midpoint 128, and reconstructed -1000..1000 ms axes even though the current response-locked tensors span 257 samples over -1.0s..1.0s. Fix the benchmark, shared artifact-saving layer, and affected downstream scripts to use a canonical timing helper derived from config or saved metadata, make outputs explicitly response-relative, and stop overloading *_weights artifacts with mode-rank traces.

title: Implement paper-aligned HoSVD vs HO-RLSL benchmark pipeline
description: Refactor HO-RLSL toward the Ozdemir 2017 formulation, add a HoSVD baseline, normalize tensor-stream handling, and add synthetic plus EEG benchmark outputs so the repository can compare both algorithms on the same pipeline.

title: Run simulation for 45 questions and 5 students
description: Execute agent-to-agent simulations for 45 questions across 5 student personas (Weak, Average, Good, etc.). Use batching (e.g., 5-10 sims/batch) to manage memory and token usage. Save results to data/processed/simulation_results.json.

title: Tighten HO-RLSL sparse recovery toward GTCS-S and full paper replication
description: The current benchmark pipeline uses a practical tensor sparse-recovery approximation instead of a full GTCS-S implementation and was validated with tests plus EEG end-to-end runs. Follow up by evaluating whether exact GTCS-S style recovery and broader paper-size synthetic runs materially change interval detection or denoising results.
